name: AMS Nova
author: AMS
description: The single default theme: a full-colour sidebar-navigation theme with dark and light options, a proper hero header, clean cards, a proper footer, AdSense-ready ad slots on posts, and a changeable colour scheme. Every page, sub-page and post uses the same shell.

settings.label: Sidebar heading
settings.help: Shown above the page navigation in the sidebar.

settings.label: Sidebar intro
settings.help: A short line under the sidebar heading.

settings.label: Hero eyebrow
settings.help: The small label above the hero title on the home page.

settings.label: Hero heading
settings.help: Leave empty to use the site title.

settings.label: Hero paragraph
settings.help: Leave empty to use the tagline from Settings.

settings.label: Post ad slot 1 — after the article
settings.help: Paste your ad code (AdSense or another network). Empty means no slot is printed. Follow the network's policy: ads on posts only, never next to a button, never on a page with little text.

settings.label: Post ad slot 2 — end of the post
settings.help: A second slot after the comments. Only worth using on posts of 1000+ words.

settings.label: Sidebar colour
settings.help: The sidebar's background. One of the four changeable theme colours.

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.help: Links, buttons and the active navigation item.

changelog.notes: First release: one full-colour sidebar theme with dark and light options, a hero header, cards, a footer and AdSense-ready ad slots.

widgets.label: After a post
widgets.help: Shown after the post content, above the footer.
